verses.original: הַֽלְלוּיָ֨הּ׀ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·yāh hō·w·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Hallelujah Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever . . .
verses.literalPt: LOUVAI ao SENHOR. Louvai ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque a sua misericórdia dura para sempre.

verses.original: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל־ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî yə·mal·lêl gə·ḇū·rō·wṯ Yah·weh yaš·mî·a‘ kāl- tə·hil·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim . . . His praise
verses.literalPt: Quem pode contar as obras poderosas do SENHOR? Quem anunciará os seus louvores?

verses.original: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל־ עֵֽת׃
verses.literal: Blessed are those who uphold justice who practice righteousness at all times
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os que guardam o juízo, o que pratica justiça em todos os tempos.

verses.original: זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.literal: Remember me O LORD in Your favor to Your people visit me with Your salvation
verses.literalPt: Lembra-te de mim, SENHOR, segundo a tua boa vontade para com o teu povo; visita-me com a tua salvação.

verses.original: לִרְא֤וֹת׀ בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־ נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lir·’ō·wṯ bə·ṭō·w·ḇaṯ bə·ḥî·re·ḵā liś·mō·aḥ bə·śim·ḥaṯ gō·w·ye·ḵā lə·hiṯ·hal·lêl ‘im- na·ḥă·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation and give glory with Your inheritance
verses.literalPt: Para que eu veja os bens de teus escolhidos, para que eu me alegre com a alegria da tua nação, para que me glorie com a tua herança.

verses.original: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־ אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃
verses.literal: We have sinned like our fathers we have done wrong and acted wickedly
verses.literalPt: Nós pecamos como os nossos pais, cometemos a iniqüidade, andamos perversamente.

verses.original: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם׀ לֹא־ הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־ רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־ יָ֣ם בְּיַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim lō- hiś·kî·lū nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā lō zā·ḵə·rū ’eṯ- rōḇ ḥă·sā·ḏe·ḵā way·yam·rū ‘al- yām bə·yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders . . . or remember Your abundant kindness but they rebelled by the sea there at the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Nossos pais não entenderam as tuas maravilhas no Egito; não se lembraram da multidão das tuas misericórdias; antes o provocaram no mar, sim no Mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־ גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name to make His power known
verses.literalPt: Não obstante, ele os salvou por amor do seu nome, para fazer conhecido o seu poder.

verses.original: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḡ·‘ar bə·yam- sūp̄ way·ye·ḥĕ·rāḇ way·yō·w·lî·ḵêm bat·tə·hō·mō·wṯ kam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: He rebuked the Red Sea and it dried up He led them through the depths as through a desert
verses.literalPt: Repreendeu, também, o Mar Vermelho, e este se secou, e os fez caminhar pelos abismos como pelo deserto.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.literal: He saved them from the hand that hated them He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy
verses.literalPt: E os livrou da mão daquele que os odiava, e os remiu da mão do inimigo.

verses.original: וַיְכַסּוּ־ מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵas·sū- ma·yim ṣā·rê·hem ’e·ḥāḏ mê·hem lō nō·w·ṯār
verses.literal: The waters covered their foes not one of them remained
verses.literalPt: E as águas cobriram os seus adversários; nem um só deles ficou.

verses.original: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise
verses.literalPt: Então creram nas suas palavras, e cantaram os seus louvores.

verses.original: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹֽא־ חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mi·hă·rū šā·ḵə·ḥū ma·‘ă·śāw lō- ḥik·kū la·‘ă·ṣā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel
verses.literalPt: Porém cedo se esqueceram das suas obras; não esperaram o seu conselho.

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ־ אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert
verses.literalPt: Mas deixaram-se levar à cobiça no deserto, e tentaram a Deus na solidão.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên lā·hem še·’ĕ·lā·ṯām way·šal·laḥ rā·zō·wn bə·nap̄·šām
verses.literal: So He granted their request but sent a wasting disease upon them
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes cumpriu o seu desejo, mas enviou magreza às suas almas.

verses.original: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·qan·’ū lə·mō·šeh bam·ma·ḥă·neh lə·’a·hă·rōn qə·ḏō·wōš Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the camp they envied Moses as well as Aaron the holy one of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E invejaram a Moisés no campo, e a Arão, o santo do SENHOR.

verses.original: תִּפְתַּח־ אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל־ עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃
verses.literal: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan it covered . . . the assembly of Abiram
verses.literalPt: Abriu-se a terra, e engoliu a Datã, e cobriu o grupo de Abirão.

verses.original: וַתִּבְעַר־ אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.literal: Then fire blazed through their company flames consumed the wicked
verses.literalPt: E um fogo se acendeu no seu grupo; a chama abrasou os ímpios.

verses.original: יַעֲשׂוּ־ עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃
verses.literal: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image
verses.literalPt: Fizeram um bezerro em Horebe e adoraram a imagem fundida.

verses.original: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת־ כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֥וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃
verses.literal: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating . . . ox
verses.literalPt: E converteram a sua glória na figura de um boi que come erva.

verses.original: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.literal: They forgot God their Savior who did great things in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Esqueceram-se de Deus, seu Salvador, que fizera grandezas no Egito,

verses.original: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל־ יַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ bə·’e·reṣ ḥām nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: wondrous works in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Maravilhas na terra de Cão, coisas tremendas no Mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·haš·mî·ḏām lū·lê mō·šeh ḇə·ḥî·rōw ‘ā·maḏ bap·pe·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nāw lə·hā·šîḇ ḥă·mā·ṯōw mê·haš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: So He said He would destroy them had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them
verses.literalPt: Por isso disse que os destruiria, não houvesse Moisés, seu escolhido, ficado perante ele na brecha, para desviar a sua indignação, a fim de não os destruir.

verses.original: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא־ הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·’ă·sū bə·’e·reṣ ḥem·dāh lō- he·’ĕ·mî·nū liḏ·ḇā·rōw
verses.literal: They despised the pleasant land they did not believe His promise
verses.literalPt: Também desprezaram a terra aprazível; não creram na sua palavra.

verses.original: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā·ḡə·nū ḇə·’ā·ho·lê·hem lō šā·mə·ʿû bə·qō·wl Yah·weh
verses.literal: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Antes murmuraram nas suas tendas, e não deram ouvidos à voz do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.literal: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Por isso levantou a sua mão contra eles, para os derrubar no deserto;

verses.original: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.literal: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands
verses.literalPt: Para derrubar também a sua semente entre as nações, e espalhá-los pelas terras.

verses.original: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·ṣā·mə·ḏū lə·ḇa·‘al pə·‘ō·wr way·yō·ḵə·lū ziḇ·ḥê mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods
verses.literalPt: Também se juntaram com Baal-Peor, e comeram os sacrifícios dos mortos.

verses.original: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרָץ־ בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.literal: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds and a plague broke out among them
verses.literalPt: Assim o provocaram à ira com as suas invenções; e a peste rebentou entre eles.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃
verses.literal: But Phinehas stood and intervened and the plague was restrained
verses.literalPt: Então se levantou Finéias, e fez juízo, e cessou aquela peste.

verses.original: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless . . . generations to come
verses.literalPt: E isto lhe foi contado como justiça, de geração em geração, para sempre.

verses.original: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־ מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·ṣî·p̄ū ‘al- mê mə·rî·ḇāh way·yê·ra‘ lə·mō·šeh ba·‘ă·ḇū·rām
verses.literal: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD and trouble came to Moses because of them
verses.literalPt: Indignaram-no também junto às águas da contenda, de sorte que sucedeu mal a Moisés, por causa deles;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־ רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃
verses.literal: For they rebelled against His Spirit and Moses spoke rashly with his lips
verses.literalPt: Porque irritaram o seu espírito, de modo que falou imprudentemente com seus lábios.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them
verses.literalPt: Não destruíram os povos, como o SENHOR lhes dissera.

verses.original: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs
verses.literalPt: Antes se misturaram com os gentios, e aprenderam as suas obras.

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.literal: They worshiped their idols which became . . . a snare to them
verses.literalPt: E serviram aos seus ídolos, que vieram a ser-lhes um laço.

verses.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־ בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃
verses.literal: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
verses.literalPt: Demais disto, sacrificaram seus filhos e suas filhas aos demônios,

verses.original: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־ בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·pə·ḵū ḏām nā·qî dam- bə·nê·hem ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯê·hem ’ă·šer zib·bə·ḥū la·‘ă·ṣab·bê ḵə·nā·‘an wat·te·ḥĕ·nap̄ hā·’ā·reṣ bad·dā·mîm
verses.literal: They shed innocent blood the blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan and the land was polluted with blood
verses.literalPt: E derramaram sangue inocente, o sangue de seus filhos e de suas filhas que sacrificaram aos ídolos de Canaã; e a terra foi manchada com sangue.

verses.original: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds
verses.literalPt: Assim se contaminaram com as suas obras, e se corromperam com os seus feitos.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people and He abhorred His own inheritance
verses.literalPt: Então se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra o seu povo, de modo que abominou a sua herança.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־ גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ- gō·w·yim way·yim·šə·lū ḇā·hem śō·nə·’ê·hem
verses.literal: He delivered them into the hand of the nations and those who hated them ruled over them
verses.literalPt: E os entregou nas mãos dos gentios; e aqueles que os odiavam se asSENHORearam deles.

verses.original: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand
verses.literalPt: E os seus inimigos os oprimiram, e foram humilhados debaixo das suas mãos.

verses.original: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·‘ā·mîm rab·bō·wṯ yaṣ·ṣî·lêm wə·hêm·māh yam·rū ḇa·‘ă·ṣā·ṯām way·yā·mōk·kū ba·‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: Many times He rescued them but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity
verses.literalPt: Muitas vezes os livrou, mas o provocaram com o seu conselho, e foram abatidos pela sua iniqüidade.

verses.original: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־ רִנָּתָֽם׃
verses.literal: Nevertheless He heard their cry He took note of their distress . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, atendeu à sua aflição, ouvindo o seu clamor.

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr lā·hem bə·rî·ṯōw way·yin·nā·ḥêm kə·rōḇ ḥas·dō
verses.literal: And He remembered His covenant with them and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion
verses.literalPt: E se lembrou da sua aliança, e se arrependeu segundo a multidão das suas misericórdias.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל־ שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.literal: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive
verses.literalPt: Assim, também fez com que deles tivessem misericórdia os que os levaram cativos.

verses.original: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־ הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·qab·bə·ṣê·nū min- hag·gō·w·yim lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ lə·šêm qāḏ·še·ḵā lə·hiš·tab·bê·aḥ biṯ·hil·lā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Save us O LORD our God and gather us from the nations that we may give thanks to Your holy name that we may glory in Your praise
verses.literalPt: Salva-nos, SENHOR nosso Deus, e congrega-nos dentre os gentios, para que louvemos o teu nome santo, e nos gloriemos no teu louvor.

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ־ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־ הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם׀ וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל־ הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl min- hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ hā·‘ō·w·lām wə·’ā·mar kāl- hā·‘ām ’ā·mên hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD the God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting Let all the people say Amen Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus de Israel, de eternidade em eternidade, e todo o povo diga: Amém. Louvai ao SENHOR.
